note: Uzbekistan's biometric passport for travel abroad. The Law on State Duty (ZRU-600 of 6 January 2020, section 6 of its rates) sets the duty at 1 base calculation value (BRV), and 80 per cent of one for a citizen under 16; the BRV is 440,000 sum from 1 September 2026 (Decree UP-115 of 23 June 2026, as buxgalter.uz reports it), so 440,000 and 352,000 sum. Applied for through the Single Portal it's 396,000 sum (0.9 BRV, the electronic discount), as my.gov.uz shows; the portal's price for a child isn't shown, so it's left unknown. my.gov.uz gives 10 working days (a month for some applicants of 16 to 25 needing more checking, not modelled). Validity is the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No. 49 of 30 January 2020 (amended by No. 492 of 2022), point 10: two years from birth to one, five years from one to 25, ten years after; that regulation is the consular one, its validity taken for every passport. The duty's exemptions and the consular fee abroad aren't modelled.
